nodes.title: html
nodes.tagline: the `html` primitive — the bounded escape hatch for the long tail

content.content: A shape the library does not have yet.

blocks.text: The ONLY untrusted slot in a std-doc. ~75% of the corpus's 1,070 CSS classes appear in exactly one document — that tail is per-document invention, and no library will ever enumerate it. This is what the tail gets, so an author is never blocked on a missing shape.

Every block is parsed and RE-SERIALIZED from the parse tree, never regex-filtered. Violations are refused LOUDLY and nothing is ever silently stripped. script, on* handlers, style=, src, iframe and img are rejected; use the utility classes for colour so it themes under --style.
